lines.zh: 我穿过暗叶林，身上还亮着。
lines.en: I cross the Darkleaf Woods, still glowing.

lines.zh: 我的光在树干上滑过去。
lines.en: My glow slides over the trunks.

lines.zh: 我爬得很低，肚皮贴着落叶。
lines.en: I crawl low with my belly on the leaves.

lines.zh: 暗叶林里，我身上微微发亮。
lines.en: In the Darkleaf Woods, I glow faintly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面拖着光。
lines.en: My tail drags a line of light.

lines.zh: 我绕开一丛发亮的蘑菇。
lines.en: I go around a patch of glowing mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我贴在树根上不动声色。
lines.en: I press against the roots, unnoticed.
I crawl slowly toward you.
A few lights glimmer on my back.
Leaves rustle under me.

lines.zh: 我停下来，光也暗了一下。
lines.en: I stop and my glow dims.
I keep going.
I lie on the leaves, glowing.
My light brightens and dims.
I see well in the dark.
I flick my tongue out slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身体一圈一圈地亮。
lines.en: The light runs along my body in rings.
Insects sing in the woods.
I lower myself again.
My scales are thin.
I am waiting for something warm.
I rear up, my glow on you.
I do not start trouble.

lines.zh: 你不看我的时候我会动。
lines.en: I move when you are not looking.
My glow reaches far.

lines.zh: 你踩的那片叶子下面有我。
lines.en: I am under the leaf you stepped on.

lines.zh: 暗叶林里，我的光先到你脸上。
lines.en: In the darkleaf woods, my glow reaches your face first.

lines.zh: 你的脸被我的光照亮了。
lines.en: My glow lights your face.
My glow retreats half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的亮光闪了两下才稳住。
lines.en: My glow flickers twice before it steadies.

lines.zh: 我收成一圈，把肚子护住。
lines.en: I curl into a ring, guarding my belly.
I slide aside.
Two scales fall off.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘紧了，光在抖。
lines.en: I coil tighter, my light trembling.
I rub against the leaves.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩得我鳞片发麻。
lines.en: That stamp leaves my scales numb.
I am still holding.
I leap before I strike.

lines.zh: 那点干粮，我连头都不抬。
lines.en: At that dry ration I do not even lift my head.

lines.zh: 你把东西摆到落叶上，我游近了。
lines.en: You set it on the leaf litter and I glide nearer.

lines.zh: 血腥味从你袖口飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts from your sleeve.
That is more interesting than this.
I stretch my head over and sniff.

lines.zh: 收回去，我只对活物有兴趣。
lines.en: Put it away; only living things interest me.
I back away slowly.
Chew that thing yourself.
I generally do not eat things that are already dead.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的光晃了一下。
lines.en: You bump me and my glow wavers.
I let go at once.
We crush the leaves.
I slide back to the roots.
My glow clings to your boot.
Don't step on me in the darkleaf woods.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，光就暗了一格。
lines.en: One bump and my glow drops a notch.

lines.zh: 我退半步，还没打算动手。
lines.en: I back off half a pace, not yet fighting.
There are other lights in the woods.
Two glows close in between the trunks.
We coil into a ring.
Our lights overlap in two layers.
There is no sound.
The leaves are a little cool.
We slowly separate.
Two trails of light move apart.
The woods dim again.
Only my glow remains.

lines.zh: 我张嘴衔住那块发亮的东西。
lines.en: I open my jaws and take the shining thing.
It grows hot in my mouth.
I coil around it and look.
This thing is a little bright.

lines.zh: 我一仰头，把它咽了下去。
lines.en: I tip my head back and swallow it.

lines.zh: 味道不对，我又吐回叶子上。
lines.en: The taste is wrong, so I spit it back onto the leaves.
Not good.
I shove it against your boot.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖被踩，光一下亮了。
lines.en: You step on my tail tip and my light flares.
My glow flares up.
My teeth are small but many.
I coil around you.
You are backed against the roots.

lines.zh: 我的前半身立起来，牙露出来。
lines.en: I rear up, baring my teeth.

lines.zh: 林子里的光都朝这边来。
lines.en: The lights in the woods turn this way.
Do not duck into the ferns.
I slide across the fallen leaves toward you.
I can see your ankle.
I follow along the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的光暴露了我的位置。
lines.en: My glow gives me away.
You have looked back several times.
I pass between the roots.

lines.zh: 我的光在地上拖出一条线。
lines.en: My glow draws a line on the ground.
You go deeper into the woods.
The woods grow denser.
I wait for your leg to come near.
I coil on that branch.
I listen to the leaves.
You crush another leaf.
I coil my body into an arc.
This time you will not leave.
I coil myself tight.
The light grows stronger.

lines.zh: 你转过来时我在你脚下。
lines.en: When you turn, I am at your feet.
I bite your calf.
I loop around your ankle and draw tight.
My teeth sink in.
I leap onto you.
My tail whips your face.
You throw me off.
I land and coil again.
My teeth skid across the top of your boot.
Light covers my body.
In the darkleaf woods, I glow.
One of my teeth breaks.
Your blood drips on the leaves.
I coil tighter.
You cannot breathe.
I rear up.
It is nearly over.

lines.zh: 我的光先在落叶上亮起来。
lines.en: My glow appears on the leaves first.

lines.zh: 暗叶林里多了一道亮线。
lines.en: A bright line joins the Darkleaf Woods.
My first glow is faint.
The leaves hide half of me.
I lift my head to the tree.
I try crawling a short way.
My scales begin to shine.
Something moves deeper in.
I settle down.
Fire nears and my glow shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，砸在落叶上。
lines.en: I drop from the tree onto the leaves.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，我的光在水下发闷。
lines.en: Water presses down and my glow dulls beneath it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我甩开，光都断了。
lines.en: The blast throws me off and my light breaks.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我的鳞片之间。
lines.en: An arrowhead lodges between my scales.

lines.zh: 一阵光压过来，我的亮光被盖住了。
lines.en: A stronger light presses in and mine is drowned out.
My glow weakens.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身都在闪。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body flickers.

lines.zh: 虚空里我什么都照不亮。
lines.en: In the void I can light nothing.
